title: Check the MIME type of a file
summary: Use the `file` command with the `-i` flag to get the MIME type (e.g., text/plain, image/png) of a file. This is often used by web servers and email clients to determine how to handle a file.

steps.explain: Run the `file` command with the `-i` (or `--mime`) flag followed by the path to the file. It will output the MIME encoding type.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to check.

steps.expect: Output showing the MIME type, e.g., 'image/jpeg'.

alternatives.explain: Query the MIME type of a file. Replace <FILE> with the path to the file.
